basic_info.description: With sweeping and unimpeded views to the  Bay Bridge, and the iconic Cupid's Span  sculpture, this waterfront luxury corner home features 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a balcony, an expansive great room for entertaining, and a full gourmet kitchen including Gaggenau appliances, an oversized glorious white marble island with seating, and a built-in wine cooler. The primary bedroom is completely separate from guest bedrooms, with direct bay views, and features an ensuite 5 piece bathroom, designed to rival any 5-star hotel. Designed by world-renown architect Skidmore, Ownings & Merrill. Amenities include valet parking, attended lobby, lounge w/ full kitchen & waterfront terrace, Wellness Center w/complete fitness & spa facilities including steam, sauna & outdoor hot spa and more.
